help.faq1Q: How do I track an order?
help.faq1A: Open the Orders screen, tap the delivery you want to follow and select "Track". You will see the driver's live location and the latest status updates.
help.faq2A: A pending order is waiting for a driver to accept it. You can check the assigned fleet, contact your driver, or cancel the order from the order details screen.
help.faq3Q: How do I update my profile or password?
help.faq3A: Go to Settings from the menu. Use "Change Password" to update your credentials and the Profile screen to refresh your contact details.
help.faq4Q: The phone number I entered is not accepted.
help.faq4A: Phone numbers must match the country code you used when registering. If you still face issues, contact support with your full name and the email on your account.
help.faq5Q: How do I report a problem with a delivery?
help.faq5A: Open the order, tap Report a Problem and pick your issue. You can also reach our support team directly from this screen — use the button below.
